summary: Iteration 7 verifies the resilient HD-download workflow end-to-end (SendGrid intentionally revoked / 401). Backend: pytest 5/5 PASS in new class TestResilientValidate (admin token Noclan97140$). POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/validate now returns HTTP 200 (NOT 502) even when SendGrid fails; response carries status='completed', validated_at, download_token, download_expires_at (~48.0h delta verified), download_url == 'https://image-select-pay.emergent.host/download/<token>' (absolute, PUBLIC_BASE_URL prefix), email_sent=false, and email_error containing the friendly French message 'Clé SendGrid invalide ou révoquée…'. GET /api/admin/orders now also returns download_url on completed orders so the admin can re-copy after reload. Re-calling validate on a completed order is idempotent: SAME download_token / download_url / validated_at / expires_at; email_sent stays unchanged (no re-send). /api/download/{token} returns 200 with photos[]; /api/download/{token}/file/{photo_id} returns 200 with content-disposition. Backend logs confirm '[ORDER VALIDATED] id=… token=… url=https://image-select-pay.emergent.host/download/…' and '[SENDGRID FAILED] … 401 unauthorized' + '[EMAIL FAILED] … error=Clé SendGrid invalide ou révoquée …' lines. Frontend (Playwright 1920x1080): admin login with Noclan97140$, create test order via POST /api/orders (qa-test@npp.io, paypal, 3€), click 'Valider & envoyer' (native confirm() dialog auto-accepted), the new DownloadLinkBand renders inside the order card with all expected test-ids: admin-download-link-band, admin-email-error (text contains the SendGrid French message), admin-download-url (= https://image-select-pay.emergent.host/download/<token>), admin-copy-link-btn. Clicking copy → button label flips to 'Copié' and toast 'Lien HD copié dans le presse-papier' appears. Status pill correctly shows 'Validée · email à envoyer manuellement' (amber, not the green 'email envoyé' variant). After a full page reload the band is STILL visible with the EXACT same URL — proves persistence via list_orders.download_url. Public preview /download/{token} page shows 'Vos photos sont prêtes' + photo tile. Order DELETE cleanup OK. Two notes from the broader pytest run: 31/33 passed; the 2 failures in the full suite were ConnectTimeout flakes to the preview host (network), not product issues — those exact tests pass in isolation 5/5.

minor.issue: email_sent=false / email_error populated because SENDGRID_API_KEY is revoked. EXPECTED + MOCKED per review request. Order state is fully persisted (status=completed, download_token, download_url, download_expires_at).

action_items: (Optional / out of scope) Replace the revoked SENDGRID_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env to flip email_sent=true. The new resilient flow handles failure gracefully so this is not a blocker.
(Non-blocking) Consider replacing native confirm() in handleValidate / handleDeleteOrder with a styled modal — small UX polish, also makes E2E easier without a dialog handler.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L719-794 validate_order: idempotent path correctly recomputes download_url from PUBLIC_BASE_URL on already-completed orders (covers env-domain changes). Never raises on email failure — exactly the required behaviour. Logs both [ORDER VALIDATED] (info) and [EMAIL OK]/[EMAIL FAILED] (info/error) lines. Good.

server.py L711-716 list_orders: now injects download_url for any order with a download_token. Note: it injects for ALL such orders regardless of status — currently only completed orders have a download_token so this is correct in practice, but explicit `if o.get('status') == 'completed'` would be more defensive.
server.py L864-906 _send_download_email: friendly French mapping for 401/403 SendGrid errors is clear and actionable; raw error is still logged for diagnostics. Good.

server.py L1024-1030 (_finalize_paid_order, Stripe path): also calls _send_download_email and persists email_sent — consistent with the manual-validate path. However, unlike validate_order, it does NOT persist email_error in DB on the Stripe finalization path. If Stripe customers hit a SendGrid failure, the admin UI will see email_sent=false but no email_error string for that order. Recommend mirroring the validate_order pattern: `await db.orders.update_one(..., {'$set': {'email_sent': sent, 'email_error': send_error}})`.

Admin.jsx L800-895 DownloadLinkBand: clean, accessible, has clipboard fallback (textarea + execCommand) for iOS Safari. data-testids present on all four required elements (band/error/url/copy-btn) + admin-open-link-btn for direct nav. Good.
Admin.jsx L206-233 handleValidate: uses native browser confirm() — works but blocks E2E unless a dialog handler is attached. Consider a styled modal for production polish.
Admin.jsx L943-951 status pill: correctly differentiates email_sent=true (green 'email envoyé') vs email_sent=false on a completed order (amber 'email à envoyer manuellement'). Matches the spec.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL in backend/.env updated to https://image-select-pay.emergent.host (was Netlify). All validate / list_orders responses now emit absolute URLs against the prod domain as required.

rca of the issue: Original bug: validate_order raised HTTPException(502, 'Commande validée mais email NON envoyé') when SendGrid failed, so the admin UI got an error toast even though the order WAS completed in DB — leaving the customer paid + admin with no usable link. Fix verified: (1) Order model gained email_error and download_url fields; (2) validate_order now ALWAYS returns 200, computes the absolute download_url from PUBLIC_BASE_URL, persists email_sent + email_error, and logs [EMAIL OK] / [EMAIL FAILED] with the friendly French message ('Clé SendGrid invalide ou révoquée…'); (3) list_orders re-injects download_url on every completed order so the band persists after reload; (4) Admin.jsx renders a DownloadLinkBand with an amber warning, the copy-paste url (test-id admin-download-url) and a copy-to-clipboard button (with iOS Safari textarea fallback). End-to-end confirmed with a real order: pyTest 5/5 + Playwright full flow + persistence reload + public /download/{token} render.
